title: Wren and the Kitchen
author: Beatrix Joubert
blurb: Lena Joubert, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
